definitions.full: H1638. garas [ גָּרַס ] verb be crushed (Aramaic [ be crushed,] perish ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular גָָּֽרְסָה Psa 119:20 figurative ׳ג לְ נַפְשִׁי my soul is crushed (i.e. perisheth: compare Syriac) with longing for (compare לְ כָּלָה ). Hiph`il Imperfect שִׁנָּ֑י בֶּחָצָץ וַיַּגְרֵס Lam 3:16 and he hath crushed my teeth with gravel , figurative of divine chastisement.
